svg.title: Pulse timing
svg.desc: Curves of radiator surface temperature over elapsed time, with a valve-state strip aligned below. While the valve is open at its fixed opening the surface warms; the valve closes at the learned cutoff, and the surface keeps warming briefly before it peaks. After peak confirmation the radiator cools while heat still flows into the room. When it reaches the restart threshold and the room still needs heat, a second pulse at the same opening begins and closes at the same cutoff. A second panel, adaptive cooling (optional), compares two alternative conditions on the same scale: with a large deficit and slow warming a higher restart threshold allows an earlier pulse; when the room is approaching target the base threshold leaves more cooling first. One threshold applies per cooling episode and it does not move during it.

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Restart if heat is still needed
Closed: heat still flows into the room
Each pulse uses the same fixed valve opening
After peak confirmation, adaptive mode selects a restart threshold for that cooling episode.
